content_sections.heading: NIAB Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Scientist-B and 1 for Farm Manager.

content_sections.heading: NIAB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Scientist-B: M.V.Sc/ M.Sc/ M.Tech or equivalent degree from a recognized University with outstanding academic & publication record along with 3 years of R&D experience in any of the NIAB thrust areas. Farm Manager: Graduation in Animal husbandry / horticulture or Masters in Life Sciences with minimum of 50 % marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIAB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIAB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB). It is a prominent government organization focusing on animal biotechnology research and development, offering stable career opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIAB Recruitment 2026 has announced vacancies for two posts: Scientist-B and Farm Manager. These positions offer diverse roles within the institute, catering to different academic backgrounds and experiences.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are there in this NIAB recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced in the NIAB Recruitment 2026. This includes one position for Scientist-B and one for Farm Manager, providing opportunities for specialized candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for NIAB Various Posts Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NIAB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website within the specified application period to be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What are the important dates for applying to NIAB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 12 August 2026, and the last date for submitting applications is 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in the NIAB Recruitment 2026 is 35 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion as of the specified cut-off date to be eligible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Scientist-B post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Scientist-B post is Pay Level 10 as per the 7th CPC. This offers a competitive remuneration package, making it an attractive opportunity for qualified candidates in the field.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates for Scientist-B?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates applying for the Scientist-B post are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/-. Different fees apply for other categories and posts, as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIAB Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for NIAB Recruitment 2026 includes a Written Test followed by a Skill Test. Candidates must perform well in both stages to be considered for final selection for the respective posts.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for these posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these posts is Hyderabad, Telangana. NIAB is located in Hyderabad, offering a vibrant environment for research and professional growth in animal biotechnology.
